name: privacy
purpose: Canary tracing of sensitive fields and small-cell suppression
usedFor: Proving, on every build, that sensitive facts reach only the places their class allows, and finding the field that leaked and where. `safeRate` and `safeCount` suppress any figure about fewer than five people.
notFor: Detecting sensitive data you did not plant (it traces declared fields, not free text a person types into a note), encryption (the runtime block seals facts), or access control (the app's sign-in and roles decide who sees what).
